title: #204 Leaving Homes
prompt: Young people are leaving their homes from rural areas to study or work in the cities. What are the reasons? Do advantages of this development outweigh its disadvantages?

promptSegments.text: Young people are leaving their homes from rural areas to study or work in the cities.
Do advantages of this development outweigh its disadvantages?

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main reason for young people moving is the better job opportunities in big cities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main reason for young people moving is the better job opportunities in big cities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A good solution is for the government to help small towns improve their services so people can stay.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A good solution is for the government to help small towns improve their services so people can stay.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary cause of young people leaving rural areas is the search for better job opportunities and educational chances in big cities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary cause of young people leaving rural areas is the search for better job opportunities and educational chances in big cities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution to this problem is improving the infrastructure and job options within rural areas to make them more attractive.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution to this problem is improving the infrastructure and job options within rural areas to make them more attractive.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary driver of young people leaving rural areas is the search for better economic opportunities and advanced amenities found in cities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary driver of young people leaving rural areas is the search for better economic opportunities and advanced amenities found in cities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A viable strategy to counteract this trend involves significant governmental investment to improve infrastructure and job prospects in rural communities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A viable strategy to counteract this trend involves significant governmental investment to improve infrastructure and job prospects in rural communities.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ liệt kê ưu nhược điểm mà quên đưa ra nhận định bắt buộc.

modelPlan.focus: Analyze the reasons behind young people migrating from rural to urban areas and evaluate whether the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.
keyArguments: Urban areas offer better job opportunities and educational amenities, which are significant pull factors for young people.
While urban migration can lead to economic growth, it also causes issues like overpopulation and infrastructure strain in cities.
